invariants.rationale: Clustering typically requires at least one output group to perform meaningful work.
Clustering only makes sense when there is data to process; an empty or null record list would have nothing to cluster.
Usually, the number of file groups is at least as many as the output groups for repartitioning records.
Clustering strategy typically depends on configuration parameters supplied in the strategyParams map.
A non-null HoodieSchema is required for writing records and schema evolution support.
